differences: The paper's Group tests (F(1,54) = 4.922 for the last three adaptation epochs; F(1,52) = 4.060 for de-adaptation; AdaptPractice F = 0.928) come from mixed models with the three words as repeated measures; the word-averaged epoch rows give F = 3.82, 3.83 and 0.933 with a plain two-way ANOVA on participant means, so these were not used as checks.
The paper says the first 6 baseline trials of each word were discarded but the normalization uses trials 6-18; the first baseline epochs are kept here as the authors shared them.
Participants' ages and sexes are not in the deposit.
